faq.q: How do I top up my AfriPay account?
faq.a: From the dashboard, tap "Top up", choose Wave, Orange Money, Moov Money, MTN MoMo, Djamo or a Visa card, then enter the amount.

faq.q: Why are my top-ups capped at 10,000 FCFA?
faq.a: Until your KYC file is approved, regulations limit your cumulative top-ups to 10,000 FCFA. Complete your KYC to lift this cap.

faq.q: How do I pay a merchant without cash?
faq.a: Open the "Pay" tab and show your AfriPay QR code to the merchant's terminal. It's the digital equivalent of presenting your palm.

faq.q: When do I need to enter my PIN code?
faq.a: The AfriPay PIN code is required to confirm any transfer of 50,000 FCFA or more.

faq.q: Having an issue with a transaction?
faq.a: Contact AfriPay support at +225 00 00 00 00 or support@afripay.africa.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms of use govern your use of the AfriPay app. This document is provided for informational purposes as part of this project and should be reviewed by legal counsel before any production use.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.body: AfriPay is a mobile payment app that lets you top up an account, transfer money, and pay for purchases at partner merchants, including by palm recognition.

sections.title: 2. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using the app, you fully accept these terms of use.

sections.title: 3. Account creation and identity verification
sections.body: You must provide accurate, up-to-date information when signing up. Some features, such as lifting the top-up cap, require your KYC file (ID document, selfie) to be approved.

sections.title: 4. Account security
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your PIN code and login credentials confidential. Report any suspicious activity immediately. You can review and revoke your connected devices from settings.

sections.title: 5. Transactions and payment methods
sections.body: Top-ups, transfers, and payments may go through third-party providers (Wave, Orange Money, Moov Money, MTN MoMo, Djamo, Visa cards). Any applicable fees will be shown before you confirm an operation.

sections.title: 6. Palm recognition payment
sections.body: Biometric enrolment is optional but required to use palm payment. Your biometric template is encrypted and used solely for payment authentication.

sections.title: 7. Account suspension and closure
sections.body: AfriPay may suspend or close an account in case of fraud, breach of these terms, or to comply with a legal or regulatory obligation.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of liability
sections.body: AfriPay is not liable for service interruptions, third-party provider outages, or losses resulting from a user's negligence in protecting their credentials.

sections.title: 9. Changes to these terms
sections.body: These terms may be updated at any time. You will be notified of any significant change via the app.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.body: For any question about these terms, contact us at the address shown in the "About" section.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how AfriPay collects, uses, and protects your personal data. This document is provided for informational purposes as part of this project and should be reviewed by legal counsel before any production use.

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
sections.body: We collect your identity information (last name, first name, phone, email, date of birth, address), your KYC documents (ID document, selfie), your encrypted biometric template, as well as your transaction history and connected-device information.

sections.title: 2. Purposes of processing
sections.body: This data is used to create and secure your account, meet our regulatory anti-fraud and anti-money-laundering (KYC/AML) obligations, process your payments, and provide support.

sections.title: 3. Legal basis
sections.body: Processing is based on the performance of our contract with you, compliance with our legal and regulatory obligations, and your explicit consent for biometric enrolment.

sections.title: 4. Data retention
sections.body: Your data is kept for as long as your account is active, then for the period required by regulations applicable to KYC records and financial transactions.

sections.title: 5. Data sharing
sections.body: Your data may be shared with our payment partners (Wave, Orange Money, Moov Money, MTN MoMo, Djamo) strictly to the extent necessary to process your operations, or with competent authorities where required by law. It is never sold to third parties.

sections.title: 6. Data security
sections.body: Your PIN code is stored encrypted, your biometric template is encrypted, and access to your data is protected and logged.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your data, within the limits of legal retention obligations. You can exercise these rights by contacting us at the address shown in the "About" section.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.body: This policy may be updated. You will be notified of any significant change via the app.
